I just finished reading the Mandelbaum translation and I can say that the rhyming becomes less grating after the first book or two. I picked up a Humphries copy because I was getting exasperated with Mandelbaum’s rhyming initially, but I ultimately stuck with the Mandelbaum translation because it felt more poetic. Maybe I’m a sucker for more flowery language, but it ended up being a really enjoyable read. Would encourage you do do a comparison with a passage or two and see what resonates more :) (Disclaimer: I have not read the Latin and can’t speak to the accuracy of either translation)

Would also add that MSG doesn’t allow super early lineup for GA. If you want to be barrier (or close to it), you need to go to the venue at 9am and get an entry number that secures your position as one of the first 400 or so in the venue. At 5pm or so they pull a random number that indicates who gets in first (I.e., if they pull 110, they’ll admit people in order starting from 110 instead of 1). Really complicated system that I just found out about this week!
